positions.as_written: Read the meniscus on sequential coronal images and count how far it extends towards the centre of the plateau.
Read the sagittal images for the continuity of the body across slices, which is the feature that distinguishes the shape.
Assess the peripheral attachments, since instability rather than shape is the operative question.
Use a fluid sensitive sequence for a tear within the thickened body.
Examine the other knee, because the shape is sometimes bilateral.
